description: Create and publish the organization's public page — a mobile business card served at https://app.qrtap.kg/a/<slug> with the name, contacts, price list and review links. Returns `slug` and `public_url`; feed that public_url to qrtap_create_code to get a printable card. WARNING: a workspace has exactly ONE page, and if one already exists this REPLACES its whole content with what you send. Every field you leave out is dropped from the live page. Never reach for this tool to add or change something on a page that exists: call qrtap_get_page first, merge your change into the content it returns, and send the merged object through qrtap_update_page. Retrying with the SAME content is safe: the slug never changes, so an already printed QR keeps working, and the replaced version stays in the page's history.

content.description: Page content. `name` is required and becomes the page heading; at least one contact (phone, whatsapp, instagram or bookingUrl) is required. Everything is sanitised server-side: unknown keys are dropped, phone numbers are normalised, only http/https links survive.

name.description: Business or person name — the page heading (max 80).

phone.description: Phone in any format; stored normalised as +digits.

reviewLinks.description: Review-platform links (segment 'otzyvy'): twogis, google, yandex, flamp.

segment.description: Page kind, lowercase slug: master | vrach | psiholog | otzyvy | … Defaults to 'master'. Use 'otzyvy' for a review-funnel page.

services.description: Up to 12 services shown as a price list.

price.description: Price as free text, e.g. '1500 сом'.

socialLinks.description: Social icon row: tiktok, telegram, website, youtube.

theme.description: Accent colour preset. Defaults to emerald.

whatsapp.description: WhatsApp number; stored as a wa.me link.

name: qrtap_create_page
